title: Applied Materials fiscal Q3 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Fiscal Q3 revenue was USD 9.115 billion, operating income was USD 3.075 billion, and diluted EPS was USD 3.17.
summary: The filed 10-Q confirms accelerating fiscal-2026 quarterly revenue and operating income, USD 7.037 billion cash plus USD 7.464 billion investments, USD 6.444 billion debt, customer concentration, and material China and export-control exposure.
